Chapter 261 - 261 Waiting Silently; Maintaining Order!

Chapter 261 - 261 Waiting Silently; Maintaining Order!

261 Waiting Silently; Maintaining Order!

Jiangbei University, downstairs of the girls’ dormitory.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue had been standing under the big tree in front of the dormitory since morning. Their two pairs of bright eyes were always silently watching the distance.

Their eyes were filled with anticipation.

At this moment, their roommate, Zhao Ni, who had just returned from outside, walked forward in surprise and said, “Xia Bing, Xia Xue, why are you still here? Could it be that you’ve been standing here since this morning?”

Although Xia Bing and Xia Xue were introverted and they rarely talked to their roommates, Zhao Ni could easily feel that the two of them were very kind.

Therefore, she was very willing to be friends with them.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue did not like to lie, so they said truthfully, “Yes… That’s right.”

“What are you waiting here for? Have you had dinner?” Zhao Ni asked.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said, “Not yet.”

“Not yet? Wait, you haven’t even eaten lunch yet, have you?” Zhao Ni asked again.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded in embarrassment.

“What?!” Zhao Ni immediately widened her eyes and shouted, “What are you doing? Hurry up and eat!”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue hesitated. “We… We’re waiting for someone.”

“Who is it? Why are you waiting like this? You’ve already waited for a day! No matter who it is, it’s not worth it to wait for them like this!” Zhao Ni shouted.

After saying that, she was about to forcefully drag the two of them to the cafeteria.

At this moment, there was a sudden sound in the distance.

Then, a cool-looking helicopter appeared above the school.

This scene… attracted the attention of many people.

“F*ck! It’s a helicopter!”

“A helicopter actually came to our school!”

“So cool!”

While many people were looking up at the sky and discussing, a rope ladder descended from the helicopter.

Then, a tall and handsome figure slowly climbed down the rope ladder.

Seeing this…

Xia Bing and Xia Xue seemed to see a hot sun that was constantly approaching them, completely illuminating their eyes. Their faces became extremely bright.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “You must have waited for a long time.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue shook their heads repeatedly. Then, they seemed to have thought of something and quickly handed Lin Fan a bottle of energy drink each from their small backpacks.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan was already used to it. He took the energy drinks and drank a mouthful from each bottle.

After Xia Bing and Xia Xue saw it, the joy on their faces became even greater.

Lin Fan said, “Let’s go.”

At this moment, Zhao Ni, who had been standing at the side without saying a word, shouted, “Leave? Do you know that Xia Bing and Xia Xue have been waiting for you here for an entire day?

“They haven’t even eaten lunch or dinner yet! You still have the face to ask them to leave with you? Don’t think you’re so great just because you have money!”

Zhao Ni was also shocked by the helicopter in the sky.

Thus, she was not able to rebuke Lin Fan immediately.

Lin Fan was shocked. “What? Have you been waiting here for a day?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue lowered their heads like children who had done something wrong.

Lin Fan looked at their tired faces and thought…He could not help but recall how they had waited for him on the basketball court every day, and his heart ached slightly.

He reached out and gently stroked their heads. “Don’t be so silly in the future.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded in enjoyment.

After a pause, Lin Fan said, “It’s my fault. I didn’t say when I would pick you up yesterday.

“Alright, let’s go eat now.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue said obediently, “Okay.”

Then, Lin Fan said to Zhao Ni, “Do you want to go with us? We’re going to the concert later.”

Although Zhao Ni’s tone just now was very impolite and it could even be said to be a reprimand, Lin Fan was not angry.

It was because he understood that… Zhao Ni treated Xia Bing and Xia Xue really well.

Therefore, he had a good impression of her.

Zhao Ni seemed to realize that she seemed to have misunderstood something. She could not help but stutter, “I… I’ve already eaten, so I won’t go.”

Lin Fan did not force her. He said goodbye and entered the helicopter with Xia Bing and Xia Xue using the rope ladder.

“To the Imperial Hotel.”

“Yes!” the two pilots replied.

Rumble!

After a loud noise, the helicopter sped into the distance and stopped steadily at the landing point on the top floor of the Imperial Hotel.

Under the lead of the attendant who was already waiting on the top floor, Lin Fan and the rest quickly arrived at the VIP room.

At this moment, the table was already filled with sumptuous dishes.

Lin Fan personally scooped two bowls of soup and handed them to Xia Bing and Xia Xue, “You haven’t eaten all day. Have a bowl of soup to warm your stomachs first.”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue were like chicks pecking at rice as they kept nodding.

The bowl of soup was quickly finished.

Then, Lin Fan picked up some noodles for them and said, “Eat some more noodles to replenish your energy.”

…

While Xia Bing and Xia Xue were eating, there were already countless people standing around the Jiangbei City Stadium.

In order to prevent any accidents, police cars, fire engines, and ambulances were lined up on the side.

Standing at the entrance were men in suits and leather shoes. Some were bald, some had a buzz cut, and some had tattoos on their bodies. They exclaimed, “I’ve never seen such a big scene!”

“Brother Wang, your boss is amazing!”

“He’s amazing!”

The manager of Flying Dragon Security Company, Wang Shengli, said proudly, “Of course!”

In the past, Wang Shengli knew that Lin Fan was different.

Now, he was even more impressed by Lin Fan.

Immediately after, Wang Shengli said seriously, “As you can see, there are a lot of people here tonight. Later, you must make sure that order is maintained. Don’t let any accidents happen!”

Today, Wang Shengli transferred hundreds of security guards from Flying Dragon Security Company.

However, to be on the safe side, he called some other people over to help.

“Brother Wang, don’t worry. There won’t be any problems!”

The bald man in the suit said, “If anything happens to the area I’m in charge of, you can kick my head like a ball!”

“That’s right!”

“Me too!”

The others echoed.

“If there’s a chance in the future, I’ll let you meet my boss.” Wang Shengli nodded in satisfaction.

When everyone heard this, they all revealed an unconcealable excitement.

In their opinion…

A person who could host such a grand concert was definitely a top-notch existence.

If they could meet, it would definitely be a great thing.

“Thank you, Brother Wang!” everyone said in unison.

“Alright, it’s about time. You can let the audience in slowly.”

“Alright, we’ll go and arrange it now!”

Soon, there were long lines at the ten side doors of the Jiangbei City Stadium. Under the protection of many security guards, people walked in in an orderly manner.
